meta.name: Flight Deck
meta.notes: Primary fills the CTAs and the hazard-striped toggle guard; a lifted 'lamp' version of primary (oklch lightness ≥ .8, so it stays visible even when the primary is navy or near-black) drives the needles, annunciator lights, glows and readouts; accent tints the alternate warning lamps, tags and the ADI sky.

issues: Creativity 8: the gauge cluster, artificial horizon and guarded toggle are true to the brief, but the lower half of the homepage turns into generic boxes
Typography 7: Michroma on lit annunciators reads well, but unlit annunciators (story, CTA) show near-black text on black and look broken in static captures
Layout 6: the Feeds/gallery section is two to four giant pure-black boxes, the biggest empty area on the page. With 6 categories (stress brand) the grid leaves a lone orphan card on its own row
Catalogue 6: three instruments sit in the left half of a 1440px grid (auto-fill), so the right half is empty and the dials are too small to show off the products
Polish 6: the fixed 'Demo redesign' badge sits on top of content (it covers the first instrument's readout in the catalogue and overlaps the hero edge on the homepage)
Home instrument readouts show 'SYS --.-' until the section intersects, so captures and quick scrolls show dead displays
Brand robustness 8: the yellow and orange brands both hold up because --c-lamp is lightness-clamped; hazard stripes and annunciators recolour well
Mobile 7: the gauge cluster scales down neatly, but the instruments are small and the hero is dense
fixed: Gallery cams now sit on a brand-tinted radar graticule with a 'NO SIGNAL' readout behind each image, so a missing or slow image looks deliberate instead of a black hole. Images load eagerly, remove themselves on error, and two feeds switch to a 16:9 aspect
Unlit annunciators are now dimmed amber glass (tinted with --c-primary, text at 48% lamp) so they read as 'off but present' and the switch-on is a visible change from dim to blazing
Category grid adapts to how many categories there are: 3 or 6 become a 3-column grid, 5 becomes a 2+3 split, and with 7 the first card is a 2x2 feature tile. No more orphans
Catalogue grid uses auto-fit. Three products fill the row as large instruments with wider gutters, and one or two products are capped at 420px so they never stretch
Demo badge is no longer fixed. It sits centred in normal flow under the footer, so it never covers content (both pages)
Home instrument readouts are filled with the default spec values at load, so they never show '--.-'. The needles still sweep in when the section scrolls into view
